jobs.title: Data Integration Engineer (33252)
jobs.description: Position Description The Data Integration Engineer designs, builds, and supports the integrations that bring data from The Specialty Alliance’s enterprise financial and business systems—including NetSuite, Workday, and Coupa—into the landing zone of the Azure/Snowflake analytical environment. The role builds API-based, file-based, and other connector-based integrations that are secure, reliable, monitored, and repeatable. The role owns ingestion from source to landing: authentication, extraction, incremental loading, schema handling, error handling, logging, and delivery of raw data into Azure storage and Snowflake landing/raw schemas with complete audit metadata. Downstream normalization, modeling, and semantic-layer work is performed by data engineers and analytics engineers, who depend on this role for complete, timely, and traceable source data. Data from these systems supports financial reporting, revenue recognition, general ledger and close reconciliation, procurement and spend analytics, and workforce analytics. Integrations must meet the control, traceability, and access standards expected for financial and HR data. Key Responsibilities Integration design and build Build and maintain integrations from NetSuite, Workday, Coupa, and other financial and business systems into the Azure/Snowflake landing zone. Use the appropriate pattern for each source: REST/SOAP APIs, vendor reporting services, database or query interfaces, SFTP/flat-file exports, managed connectors, or event-driven feeds. Implement full and incremental extraction, including change detection, watermarks, pagination, rate-limit handling, retries, and historical backfills. Land data in Azure Data Lake Storage and Snowflake raw/landing schemas in source-faithful form, with load metadata (source, extract time, batch ID, record counts, file hashes). Configure Snowflake ingestion (external stages, storage integrations, COPY INTO, Snowpipe) in line with platform standards. Document each integration: source objects, fields, extraction logic, schedules, dependencies, and known limitations. Reliability, monitoring, and support Build orchestration, alerting, and logging so failures, late data, schema changes, and volume anomalies are detected quickly. Implement completeness checks and source-to-landing reconciliation (record counts, control totals) for financial and HR data. Provide production support, troubleshoot failures, perform root-cause analysis, and maintain runbooks. Meet data-delivery schedules tied to financial close and reporting calendars. Security and controls Manage credentials, OAuth clients, integration users, and certificates through Azure Key Vault and approved secret-management practices. Apply least-privilege access to source systems and landing zones in partnership with Security and system owners. Support classification and protection of sensitive data, including employee PII, compensation, banking, and vendor data. Follow change-management, code review, and CI/CD practices; keep integration code under version control. Retain extract evidence and lineage needed for audit and close support. Collaboration Work with NetSuite, Workday, and Coupa system owners and IT Enterprise Applications to understand data structures, custom fields, configuration changes, and release schedules. Coordinate with vendors on API access, limits, and support issues. Partner with the Enterprise Data Architect and data engineers on landing standards, naming, and handoff to modeled layers. Assess new source systems, including systems acquired through practice onboarding or M&A, and estimate integration effort. Qualifications Required Skills and Competencies Integration engineering: Designs reliable full and incremental extraction with retries, idempotent loads, and backfill capability. Programming: Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with JSON, XML, and CSV data structures. Data handling: Manages schema changes, nested data, data types, and late-arriving records. Operational rigor: Builds monitoring, logging, and alerting as part of every integration. Security awareness: Handles credentials and sensitive financial and HR data appropriately. Documentation: Produces clear integration specifications and runbooks. Collaboration: Works effectively with system owners, vendors, and downstream engineering teams. Required Technologies Python (requests, data-processing libraries) and SQL. Azure data services: Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Key Vault; Azure Functions or Logic Apps. Snowflake: stages, storage integrations, COPY INTO, Snowpipe, roles and grants. REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth 2.0, JSON/XML, SFTP. Git and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub). Desired Skills, Experience, And Technologies NetSuite integration: SuiteTalk REST/SOAP web services, SuiteQL, saved searches, SuiteAnalytics Connect. Workday integration: Workday web services (SOAP/REST), Reports-as-a-Service (RaaS), integration system users and security groups. Coupa integration: Coupa REST API, scheduled flat-file exports, and Coupa data objects (requisitions, POs, invoices, suppliers). Managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran, Airbyte, Matillion, or Informatica. Orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow, dbt, or Snowflake Tasks/Streams. Infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep) and Snowflake environment automation. Experience with healthcare, MSO, or multi-entity organizations, including practice-management or revenue-cycle source systems. Understanding of financial data (GL, subledgers, chart of accounts, AP, procurement) and HR data concepts. Experience supporting SOX or audit-sensitive data flows. Certifications: SnowPro Core or Data Engineer; Microsoft Azure Data Engineer Associate. Employment Notes The Specialty Alliance is an equal opportunity employer. This description reflects the principal responsibilities of the role and is not an exhaustive list; duties may change based on organizational needs.

jobs.title: Data and Reporting Analyst
jobs.description: The Data and Reporting Senior Analyst: Key Responsibilities: Work with supply chain business stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging company data to drive business solutions Assess the completeness and accuracy of new data sources and data processing techniques. Gather business requirements and determine most effective and efficient reporting platform Design and develop metrics and reports, dashboards and analyzes to drive key business decisions in the supply chain space Conduct large scale data analysis and modeling to derive actionable insights Model data and build comprehensive dashboards that evaluate business effectiveness and impact. Further improve and optimize dashboard user experience. Develop processes and tools to monitor and analyze model performance and data accuracy Automate manual execution processes Job Requirements: Will work remotely in Austin, TX. Basic Qualifications: Minimum 2 years of experience in Supply Chain/Data and Analytics Minimum 3 years of experience using SQL and data visualization tools such as PLX, Data Studio, or Tableau Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor's or higher degree in a quantitative or analytical field Proficiency in Python, R, SPSS, Minitab Understanding of end to end supply chain management and Product Lifecycle Management Ability to analyze an enormous amount of complex data, and deliver meaningful conclusions that can be turned into actionable decisions Excel/Spreadsheets Strong design skills in Interaction (User – Reports like navigation, drills, sharing etc.) Strong visualization experience – charts, bars, images, dynamic reports etc. Excellent Oral/Written Communication and Stakeholder management Skills Excellent analytical and problem solving skills Self driven, ability to work in an unstructured environment with minimal supervision Experience using statistical computer languages to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets. Experience working with and creating data architectures. Knowledge and experience in data modeling: trend analysis, linear interpolation, etc. Experience using ETL tools and standard query languages Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience.
